message: Generated from Stimulation_2emg.hex Debug build on 2026-07-05. Firmware samples ADC2 PPG at the selected 25-100 Hz PPG frame rate and samples ADC3 noise at 1 kHz internally. Each PPG sample is followed by an ADC3B batch frame so the Web GUI can extract key bits in the browser and XOR-encrypt 14-bit PPG samples without streaming every ADC3 sample as a separate UART line. BLE NUS text output is chunked to the negotiated MTU to avoid long-frame send errors.
